newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Canberra seeks comment on demutualising tax issues.
newsitem.headline: Canberra seeks comment on demutualising tax issues.

text.p: The Australian Treasury on Wednesday released an issues paper calling for public comment on taxation issues arising from the demutualisation of non-insurance companies.
The department said non-insurance organisations included friendly societies, credit unions and social clubs.
"The current taxation provisions applying to non-insurance mutuals is a matter of concern to the Treasury and the Australian Taxation Office," it said in a statement.
The department said it was concerned that an element of double taxation existed in the capital gains tax procedures.
The paper was prompted by the expectation that an increasing number of non-insurance companies would want to demutualise as the more sectors were opened to further competition, it said.
Public submissions would have to be made by July 14.
